meta.title: Implement HBlank DMA timing
meta.body_summary: Implement HBlank DMA transfers with HDMA_CYCLES_PER_BLOCK constant and cycle-accurate timing; enable in MMU clock via proper PPU mode checks, and add unit tests for General and HBlank DMA correctness.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex implemented HBlank DMA timing with HDMA cycle management; coderabbit bot noted redundant condition and method name inconsistency; author addressed with follow-up commits before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 497 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. The change adds proper HBlank DMA transfers with cycle counting and tests, consistent with a targeted emulator improvement that merged after incremental bot review.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbit identified a redundant self.dma.mode() check in the HBlank match guard and suggested using set_cycles_hdma instead of set_cycles_dma for HDMA cycle updates.
review_details.performance_claim: Implement proper HBlank DMA transfers with cycle-accurate timing for improved emulation accuracy and performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level emulation feature (HDMA timing) requires precise cycle counting and PPU mode integration; Codex successfully delivered with unit tests and bot-suggested refinements.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai bot performed static analysis, flagging a redundant match condition and method name mismatch.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR includes comprehensive unit tests for General and HBlank DMA timing, enabling verification of cycle-accurate transfers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the review, author committed 'improved HDMA cycles timing' and 'new hblank modes' tweaks, then a nitpick fix, before merging.

core_change_summary.description: Added HDMA_CYCLES_PER_BLOCK constant and cycles_hdma field to Dma struct in src/dma.rs; implemented clock_dma in mmu.rs to separately handle General and HBlank DMA modes with cycle countdown, 16-byte HBlank transfers per block, and ppu mode checks; added clear_screen helper in ppu.rs; included unit tests for General and HBlank DMA timing and correctness.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: ppu.rs added clear_screen method for reset; frontends/sdl had trivial event handling change.
change_trajectory: Initial commit implemented HBlank DMA timing with basic cycle handling.
Subsequent commits refined validations, extended HDMA cycle fields, and enhanced test coverage.
Post-review commits improved HDMA cycle timing, removed redundant HBlank guard, and fixed set_cycles_hdma naming.

review_signals.summary: Identified redundant self.dma.mode() == DmaMode::HBlank in match guard; suggested removing duplicate check.
Called set_cycles_dma but should call set_cycles_hdma for HDMA cycle tracking.
review_signals.action_taken: Addressed in commit c7a6b191 and subsequent chore commits.

review_signals.summary: Same method name issue highlighted again with verification agent confirming inconsistency.

coderabbit bot posted initial walkthrough and summary within minutes.
